# Pictogrammers timeline icons

Sunō includes four unchanged SVG icons from [Material Design Icons](https://pictogrammers.com/library/mdi/), distributed in [`@mdi/svg` version 7.4.47](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mdi/svg/v/7.4.47).

| App asset | Source icon | Author from package metadata |
| --- | --- | --- |
| TimelineLift | [gondola](https://pictogrammers.com/library/mdi/icon/gondola/) | Austin Andrews |
| TimelineRun | [ski](https://pictogrammers.com/library/mdi/icon/ski/) | Google |
| TimelineSnowboard | [snowboard](https://pictogrammers.com/library/mdi/icon/snowboard/) | Google |
| TimelineFlat | [walk](https://pictogrammers.com/library/mdi/icon/walk/) | Google |

The SVG files come from the package's `svg` directory. The asset catalog preserves vector data and uses template rendering so the interface controls their color.

The icons use the [Apache License 2.0](https://pictogrammers.com/docs/general/license/). [Pictogrammers-LICENSE.txt](Pictogrammers-LICENSE.txt) contains the package's license notice and the full Apache license.
